 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Arshdeep Singh hits back at trolls for attacking partner Samreen Kaur online 
 Arshdeep Singh took to Instagram to hit back at trolls, who have been attacking his girlfriend Samreen Kaur online over her social media posts. Arshdeep reposted the story shared by Samreen, where she called out the massive trolling, calling the people doing it "hypocrite".
 Arshdeep extended his support on the social media platform and wrote: "I’m proud of you baby. You are so strong. To all the people too concerned for what we should and what we shouldn’t do, please take a break. Live and let live."
 He added: "Make this world and internet a better place. Spread love and let love find you. Be warm and kind. It will come back to you in ways you never expected."
 The 27-year-old pacer also expressed gratitude and added: "God has been so kind to bless me with someone who is so pure, understanding and full of love. To love and to be loved is the best feeling a human can experience and I hope you all get to experience that feeling sooner than later. To all our well-wishers thank, you for the kindness and love."
 Arshdeep Singh shows his support for his partner after she opened up about facing unnecessary criticism and negativity on social media.

 “I’m proud of you baby. You are so strong… Spread love and let love find you.” Arshdeep’s heartfelt message for his loved one is winning hearts. — (@himanii_68) November 1, 2026 
 Arshdeep Singh and Samreen Kaur relationship 
 Arshdeep and Samreen had first sparked dating rumours during the IPL 2026, when they were spotted together in Dharamshala - the second home venue of Punjab Kings - the franchise the pacer plays for. The cricketer then confirmed the relationship almost a month later, announcing it on social media.
 Since then, there has been mixed reception towards the news, and the couple finally addressed the negativity around them on social media.
 What Samreen Kaur said 
 Samreen on her Instagram story wrote: "The more I see the world, the more I realise how hypocritical people on social media can be. If you hide your man, you’re apparently not proud of him enough. If you love him loudly, you’re doing it for fame. If you have standards, you’re selfish. And if you genuinely love someone for who they are and how they treat you, apparently you’re going to leave him anyway."
 Hitting back at the trolls, who have accused her of dating the cricketer for fame and luxury, she stated: "I’ve been working since I was 17, taking care of myself financially and professionally, travelling to over 20 countries, and building a happy life with or without a relationship. God has blessed me in so many ways to be able to afford my own travel and lifestyle since I was a child and I'm grateful."
 Samreen also mentioned that her team would be blocking trolls and reciprocated love to those who shower. "And I am incredibly lucky to have found someone I genuinely wish I’d met earlier. Someone who completes me in ways I don’t owe anyone an explanation for. I’ll post about myself, him, and us because that’s my life.
 "If you don’t like seeing it, feel free to leave my page. I’m especially tired of seeing women tear other women down. The unnecessary opinions, assumptions, and negativity are exhausting. Me and my team are blocking every person who's coming here to take out their personal frustrations. My profile isn’t a place to project your hate for life. And to everyone who shows us genuine love, ily guys so much x. I’m happy, I’m in love, and I’m living my life. That’s all that matters. Please let us be."
